# Daily Briefing – Thursday 30 July

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training, just 4,257 steps and a near-perfect calorie burn of 2,310 kcal, which aligns well with your 2,300 target. The main concern is that 5.5 hours of sleep, which is simply not enough for an athlete at your stage of marathon prep.

Your HRV sits at 98ms, just below your 101–118ms baseline, and that sleep deficit is almost certainly the culprit. The good news is your resting HR of 49bpm and stress score of 25/100 suggest your body isn't in crisis — just slightly under-recovered. Go ahead with today's planned session, but don't force intensity if you're feeling flat.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything. Aim for 8 hours — it's your cheapest performance enhancer. Hit your 175g protein today to support recovery, and consider front-loading it earlier in the day.
